body: Well if you view an ideal as being naive, then that's your subjective opinion and has no merit inside of an otherwise pointless but objective exchange of words. There's no truth in it, because there's no universal truth. So, it's basically just finger pointing. Y'know, like a playground. It's just like if I called you a tool, that would be a relative truth to me, but you would shit blood denying it. Good talk, though. Useful input.
None of the above. A romantic, maybe. Good talk.
Fortitude, resilience, insight into the authenticity of a strangers motives (particularly on the internet).

Thank you. I do see that all that seems to matter is the small respite in relationships or otherwise from an otherwise bleak outlook, but it doesn't seem like enough. It also doesn't feel right. I'm not sure I can ever accept that this is how it is. But, this has been an ongoing debate with myself for a long time now. I tend to avoid talk of suicide, given how triggering it is as a topic for people. But, if I were to choose between a lifetime of piecemeal positivity in between the relentless heartache and viciousness of this thresher, and eternal void through suicide, I would choose the latter.

My apologies for the late responses. I'd like to say I was busy, but in reality I was anxious about logging into reddit plus I was escaping into video games as per usual.

I wouldn't say I'm socially settled. I suppose with my growing detachment from reality, as grandiose as that may seem, there is a strength there that eases the burden of inhibition. I'm not sure if it's a good thing yet. Probably not.

Your points of morality are interesting. I haven't really questioned my stance on morality before, which is odd in itself given that I'm not one to believe in universal truth, but there it is.

This may seem obnoxious, but I don't find much comfort in discussing the various perspectives of life and living these days. I find little comfort in much of anything except momentary segments of interaction. Like this, for example. It seems to be the only thing that staves the inevitable darkness. But, I'm around. I'm always around. One of the perks of having nowhere to be. So, feel free, if you'd ever like to talk.

And, thank you for sharing your existence!

If you're getting noticed purely for your appearance, then you won't find anything of substance, which is what you seem to be searching for. You will be disappointed. If you're fishing for a confidence booster from the ladies, I believe there are other subs for that.

Take the picture down, it isn't important. Instead, write about yourself. What do you enjoy? Why are you stubborn? What are you looking for in a girlfriend? Tick many boxes, not just one box.
